sources.name: Health Quality Ontario
sources.coverage: Ontario hospitals in public performance reporting
sources.description: Published average wait times currently represented by legacy repository event tags pending revalidation against the official composite indicator definition.
limitations: Repository event tags are legacy implementation tags pending Ontario methodology revalidation
Public reporting cadence is slower than real-time dashboards
Should not be mixed with point-estimate or percentile reporting
best_for: Repository mapping audit; not source-faithful cross-province comparison until revalidation

official_indicator_definition.start: triage or registration, whichever is earlier
official_indicator_definition.end: first assessment by a doctor, nurse practitioner, physician assistant, or dentist

methodology_revalidation.resolution_required: Owner-reviewed ontology and historical measurement migration or versioning decision

levels.name: Emergent

triage_system.note: Ontario wait-time reporting is currently mapped to TRIAGE -> PHYSICIAN as legacy implementation tags; the official composite event boundaries require revalidation.

ontario_vs_ontario.reason: Current repository tags match within the maintained source, but fidelity to the official composite event boundaries remains unresolved.

ontario_vs_alberta.reason: Current repository tags share metric and event values, but statistic_type differs (MEAN vs POINT_ESTIMATE) and Ontario event fidelity remains under revalidation.

ontario_vs_bc.reason: Current repository tags share metric and event values, but statistic_type differs (MEAN vs P90) and Ontario event fidelity remains under revalidation.

ontario_vs_quebec.reason: Current repository tags differ on start_event and statistic_type, while the official Ontario composite start and provider endpoint are not yet represented exactly.
ontario_vs_quebec.divergence_brief: Methodology Divergence: Direct comparison is scientifically invalid. Ontario event tags require source-fidelity revalidation, and the reported statistics differ (MEAN vs ROLLING_AVG).

validation_checklist: Treat Ontario event tags as legacy implementation values until methodology revalidation is resolved
Raw payload is hashed rather than stored in full
